one_liner: Open-source CRM with REST and GraphQL APIs auto-generated from the workspace data model.

auth.evidence_quote: Create an API key in **Settings → API & Webhooks → + Create key**. Copy it immediately — it's shown once.
auth.notes: No OAuth flow found in the docs consulted; auth is a Bearer API key generated per workspace. Being open-source, self-hosted deployments could add their own auth in front, but the documented product auth is API-key only.

access.notes: Open-source CRM (self-hostable) and also offered as a hosted free-tier product per WebSearch summaries; a workspace signup yields an immediate API key with no review step.

api.notes: No static endpoint reference -- API is generated per-workspace schema (built-in objects + any custom objects each get REST/GraphQL endpoints), so a fixed endpoint count isn't documented; breadth estimated moderate for default object set. MCP presence not checked within call budget (third-party 'Twenty CRM' Claude Code skills appeared in search but were not verified as a real MCP server with a repo).

verdict.rationale: Free self-serve workspace with an immediately-issued API key against a REST/GraphQL API, no approval gate found.
